__broaden__.እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
__broaden__.ኪዳነ: ኪዳን — covenant (noun, m.; construct 'covenant of') · accusative 'a covenant' as object (ሀበኒኬ ኪዳነ 'give me a covenant')
__broaden__.መሐል: መሐለ — swear! (imperative 2ms, G) · in a run of verbs (ትምሕል ወታምሕል መሐል ወአምሕል 'you swear and make swear: swear! and make swear'), the same imperative; a noun 'oath' is the other possibility (?)
